sequence: gf_probe queues screen_state_work with a delay of 1250
goodixfp_init_drm_notifier can retry panel discovery for up to 25 one-second waits and then registers the notifier, storing the returned cookie

if the worker is active and has not stored its cookie when unregister runs, the unregister can miss the registration; cancel_delayed_work_sync then waits for the worker but does not unregister the newly stored cookie
gf_remove destroys the workqueue and returns with the panel notifier potentially still registered
finding_1.impact: A panel callback may remain registered beyond device removal. If the driver is subsequently unloaded, the notifier may retain a callback pointer and client_data address in module text/data that have been released. The code also allows the callback to call sendnlmsg while module exit has already begun netlink teardown.

sequence: gf_open requests the IRQ on the first open
gf_release disables and frees the IRQ only when the last open file closes
gf_remove removes fp_wakelock and destroys the device/work resources but does not disable or free that IRQ
the IRQ handler calls __pm_wakeup_event and sendnlmsg
finding_2.impact: If platform unbind occurs while the character device is open, the IRQ can remain live after gf_remove has removed the wakeup source; the handler can still run until the last file is released. This is an unverified teardown/lifetime gap, not a demonstrated invalid memory access.

module_exit_order: Ghidra stock cleanup_module and current source call netlink_exit first
platform_driver_unregister runs afterwards and invokes gf_remove
netlink_exit releases nl_sk before the remove path quiesces notifier/work/possible IRQ callbacks
limits: The teardown sequences are preserved by exact stock/candidate assembly for the current candidate hash; these are OEM-inherited risks, not reconstruction mismatches.
No device unbind, module load/unload, notifier event, IRQ stimulus, or hardware test was performed.
The driver remains STATIC_VERIFIED_OFFLINE; semantic equivalence and hardware validation are not established, and independent human review remains pending.
recommended_correction: For a declared hardening deviation, first cancel and drain screen_state_work, then unregister the final notifier cookie; quiesce any open-time IRQ before removing its wakeup source, with shared state that prevents double-free from gf_release; and unregister the platform driver before tearing down netlink. Rebuild in the canonical Docker workspace and independently review before promotion.
reconstruction_status: Exact stock reconstruction status is preserved. Both lifecycle findings remain open and are not runtime-confirmed.
